messages.author: 92a46c9449c605e2
messages.subject: Cannot install shinyapps.  Connection error reported.
parts:
Tried to install shinyapps according to instructions in Getting Started Guide ... but getting an error.

> devtools::install_github('rstudio/shinyapps')
Installing github repo shinyapps/master from rstudio
Downloading shinyapps.zip from https://github.com/rstudio/shinyapps/archive/master.zip
Error in function (type, msg, asError = TRUE)  : couldn't connect to host

Also tried the above by supplying my Github username/password to install_github().  Got same error.  Using devtools 1.4.1.

Might anyone know what's going on?

thanks
